content: Ayao manasyin
Risyirati Lukas, syo nyovara waowe so ratoe ore injayo Teopilus winai, winyirati sya injayo ko dave. Vatano wanuije inta wo Amisye apa ana po rave no wama yasyine so ratoe tavon to.
Amisye apa ana dave umaso mamo Yesus apa arakovo utavondi aije wo raeno taune mamije rai no manasyinoe, umba wo veano wansanyao.
Anakotare umawe mamo syo ranyao mavabea nugoenta to, weti syare syo ayao mamaisy inta ratoeyo namarom, injayo Teopilus,
indamu nyo raen ayao nya kurune wo nanyao rai omamo tugae rave.
Yohanes Pembaptis ano raije raurairive

Arono Herodes be akarijo titive no munijo Yudea, naije syeno tuna no Yavaro Amisye inta apa tame mirati Zakaria. Zakaria umaso pamo ato siso syeno varoro Abia mansai. Apa anamu ama tame mirati Elisabet, omamo ravaki no syeno Harun apa susye rai.
Zakaria muno Elisabet onayamo aya ana yo rave mamai no Amisye amune rai, muno javondijo Apa ananyaowe rai mavabe tenambe.
Weramu aya arikainye meweno yai weye Elisabet omamo mbakije ramu, muno wenayamo ibe vatan anuive rave to.
Noa masyote inta syeno varoro Abia mawain inda usisa wanapatambe Amisye ai no Yavaro Amisye rai, muno Zakaria panapatambe matavon.

Umba syene umaso wo aikarae rapatin, mamaisyo awa koane rai, indamu wo syen inta apatimu. Weti Zakaria opirati wo apatimu indamu po kemenyano ranavano mbovove rameseo Amisye ai no Yavaro Amisye ama uga.
Umba Zakaria siso rai, pare po kemenyane ramer, muno vatano wanuije wanunugambe no Yavaro Amisye ama akiri umba ube sambayambe.
Naije kobe naito Amisye inta anasine rarorono Zakaria ai, tet no tewa oramo kemenyane ramero raije ama ranijo anem ngkov.
Arono Zakaria po naito Amisy umaso aen, paparo ai muno jani dave.
Umba naite umaso po raura pare, “Zakaria, vemo njani nora. Amisye po nya sambaya ranaun to. Indati nya anamugo Elisabet mo arikainye inta avaki, umba apa tamo nyo veano awaine mamo Yohanes.
Indati winyamo nanayanambe rave, muno vatano wanuije wo arikainye umaso anauno anowi indati manayanambe tavon.
Weye opamo indati vatano panakoe no Amisye amun. Weti vemo po awije inta ramanam inya. Muno opamo Anawayo Vambunine mo vambunine raugaje ai no arono ta no no akoya ranobon.
Wepirati indati po vatano wanui no Israel maugavakare no awa Amisye ai.

Amisye po nya arikainye umaso atutir indamu puisyeve Ai. Po Anawayo Vambunin maisyare po raunanto Elia aijoe raunande ai indamu po Amisye apa kawasae manyao indamu wanatatayaube ra manuga ngkakavimbe arono masyoto Amisye de rai. Apa ananyaowe no taiso: ‘Are nawirati uparijo awa arikainye mai, weamo wo maneme raijar indamu manuga nsauman akato. Muno are nawirati ubeta Amisye aije ramu, weamo usakinav indamu utavondi Apa ayao mamaisye obo rai.’ ”

Umba Zakaria po raura naito Amisye umaso ai pare, “Risye sya anamu me ririmamo imbe vatan anuive to, ti rimbakije ramu. Weti nya ana ndaura wato mamo nande ririnsai tai rui? Syare nyo ana inta rarorono rinai inda syo raen ti syanave nya ayaowe rai.”
Umba naito Amisy po raura akananto ai pare, “Risyirati Gabriel, syanapatambe Amisye ai, muno Opirati po inatuti da ride syo ayao kove so raura nai.
Ana syo raurairive so indati noa masyote inta mamaisyo rai. Weramu winyamo nyanave sya ayao umawe raije jewen, ti nyayao akatoe ramu yara soamo nawa ngkao ava indati ana syo raura so mamaisy.”
Vatane umawe wo Zakaria anyut ti unantaive rave, ware, “Veanimaibe irati no no Yavaro Amisy ama uga nugoenta rave?”

Arono Zakaria puje Yavaro Amisye raora, payao nanto mai kakai weye awa ngkao, weti ana nande ai mamo po ranyijo aneme bo rai. Umba vatane umaso wo aen, ware, “Wato pamo somaida Amisye po ana inta rarorono ai no Yavaro Amisye ama uga umu to.”
Umba Zakaria panapatambe no Yavaro Amisye rai yava apa masyoto rapatimugo aije raija mewen, umba pakato no apa yavar.
Nugoenta ramu, yara kavinta nakato umba apa anamugo Elisabet ranakeave kobe, umba mainda no no yavar ava embae radani.
Mare, “Wusyinoe vatane wo inaura tantunawi weye ibakije ramu, weramu soamo Amisye po kovo manakoe raugaje rinaije so.”
Yesus apa anowe raurairive
Elisabet ranakea raena embae kaujentabo to, umba Amisye po apa naito Gabriel atutir ti poroto no munijo Nasaret, omi no no Galilea.
Poroto no wanya mansae inta ama tame mirati Maria, omi ama vainye rave irati Yusup ai, opamo avaki no Daud apa susye rai.
Naito Amisy umaso de nande Maria rai, umba po raura nanto rai pare, “Masyote ngkovo nai! Winyirati Amisye tuna nautan muno Po kovo manakoe raugaje nai.”
Maria mo naito Amisy umaso apa ana daura ranaun, naije mpaparo rai. Mo ratantona no ranuga mare, “Wakoe! Apa ayao umaso ama ntunato raije no tai rui? Syo raen kobe rainy!”
Umba naito Amisye umawe po raura nanto rai pare, “Maria, vemo njaniv inya. Amisye po napatimu indamu Po kove raugaje nai.
Indati winanakea raen umba ntuna irati arikainyo anya inta autan, nyo Apa tame veano awainamo Yesus.
Sopamo vatano pakoeve, Apa tame rawainamo Arikainyo Amisyo Titi Rave. Amisye po aijaseo be akarijo titive mamaisyo Apa aneno wusyin Daud amaisy.
Indati be akarive Apa kawasaeyo Israel
mansaija nuge nuganui.”
Umba Maria mo raura nanto naito Amisye umaso ai mare, “Ibe tai ruimai dati ana nyo raura wato mamaisy? Weye risyamo syantukamo anya inta ai rainy weye ta ino mansaevea nene.”

Naito Amisy umaso po raura akananto Maria rai pare, “Indati Anawayo Vambunine maje nai muno Amisyo Titi Rave apa vambunine no nautan indamu wimbe nanakeave. Weti indati vatane wo nya arikainye so aura ware, ‘Opamo Arikainyo Amisye pije, anuga ngkakavimbe.’
Inya! Winya arakovo Elisabet mbe vatan anuive to, weramu soamo mbe ranakeave! Wemirati vatane wo raura ware wanya nte bayave, mbakije ramu. Weramu soamo ranakea raena embae kaujentabo to.
Weye Amisye bambunin po anakotaro rui vayave raveti mamaisy.”
Umba Maria mo raura mare, “Risyamo syanapatambe Amisye ai. Nya ana ndaura umawe nande rinai kai.” Umba naito Amisye umaso po rapaya ti no.
Maria mo Elisabet rapan
Masyote inta yai jakato, umba Maria nto no munije inta rai no Yudea, ama varoro unate inta rai.
Umba moronto nsiso no Zakaria apa yavar, mo kove raura nanto Elisabet rai.
Arono Elisabet mo Maria ama ayao ranaun, umba arikainyo no no ranobone aansunuve, umba Anawayo Vambunine mo vambunine raugaje Elisabet rai,
ti mayao akoeve mare, “Wanya wanui rave no mine vone so, weramu winyirati Amisye po napatimu indamu Po apa kove raugaje nai. Muno Po apa kove raugaje arikainyo no no nanobone Ai tavon.
Wakoe! Winyamo sya Akarijo Titi apa akoya mi winy, yara risyamo vatano mamaun, weti nyo inapan, weamo mamaisye ramu.
Arono winsiso sya yavar ti syo nanamote ranaun, naije kobe sya arikainyo no no inanobon aansunuve weye anayanambe rave.
Kove ngkov irati winai, weye nyanave Amisye apa ayao rai to, nyare Apa ana po raura naije nde nande.”
Maria ngkangkamambe Amisye ai
Maria mo raura mare,

content.text: “Rikangkamambe Amisye ai no inanuga,
muno syo ararimbe weye Po inapaya ayao kakaije rai.
Risyamo vatano mamaun dave, weramu Amisye aemeno rinai to.
Weti wama susyo miridije nto nao wo inaura ware risyi syaura Apa kove rai.
Weye Amisyo Bambunin Dave opirati po ana manakoe so rave rinai.
Apa tame ndandini dave!
Amisye aemeno vatane mai ntoa awa ajavi wo mampame mai, nanawirati wo asyanive mansai tenambe.
Po apa vambunine raroron.
Po vatano manuga rararin mawatan ti unanajibe tatugadi.
Po akarijo titi maveaje,
yara Po vatano mamaun maijaseo titive.
Po anaisyo ko dave raunanto vatano marore po mave mai inda uman,
yara Po vatano awa ananuge manui rave mawatan ti unajiv manem bayave ara wusya.
Po apa arikainyo Israel wansaeranande maisyare muno Po raurairive wama aneno wusyine mansai wemaisy.
Amisye animari Apa urairije umaso raije ramu,
yara aemeno Abraham muno apa susye miridije nto mansaija nuge nuganui.”

content: Maria nowo Elisabet rarijata embae mandei, umba makato no ama yavar.
Yohanes Pembaptis ano
Masyote ndea mamaisyo akoe Elisabet mare ntuna rai, umba mo arikainyo anya inta avaki.
Ama arakove wo ranaun Amisye po kovo manakoe raugaje rai, weti ude manayanambe tenambe.
Arikainye umaso apa masyote kaumandei, umba vatane ude tenambe indamu usambayambe ai muno wo koano sunat rave ai mamaisyo Ananyao Musa rai. Umba ware wo ajayo Zakaria apa tame veano awain.
Weramu Elisabet mo raura nanto mai mare, “Wenora, yara apa tame mirati Yohanes.”
Umba vatane umawe wo raura nakananto Elisabet rai ware, “Nya arakov bakipambe re sonawamo inta apa tamo Yohanes veano inta awaino intai ramu, ti mamaisye ramu.”
Weti wo ranyijo maneme bo rai indamu wo Zakaria anajo nanto ware, “Tamo rui mirati indamu wamo veano arikainye umaso awain?”
Umba Zakaria po orame vasye inta ranajo mai, umba po ratoe rai pare, “Apa tame mirati Yohanes.” Weti vatan tenambe unantaive rave.
Naije kobe Amisye po Zakaria awa raneka umba payao akato ti po Amisye ararimbe.
Umbawe apa arakove unantaive rave ana umaso rai, muno ayao umaso ravov ti nanto no Yudea ama varodoro unate raita tenambe.
Vatano wo ranaune nao wo ratantona no manuga ware, “Wakoe! Arikainye uma wato pamo Amisye apa vambunine no ai! Weti noa panakoeyamo, indati beo animaibe?”
Zakaria kangkamambe Amisye ai
Arikainye umaso apa ajae Zakaria pamo Anawayo Vambunine mo vambunine raugaje ai umba po ayao Amisye nde ai raura pare:

content.text: “Wade wamo Israel wama Amisye ararimbe!
Weye de Apa vatane wansai to, Po wansapaya ayao kakaije rai.
Po Vatano vambunine inta atutir indamu Po wansapaya ayao kakaije rai.
Opamo Mesias, napi avaki no Daud apa susye rai,
maisyare muno Amisye po raurairive Apa anawae wusyine mai wemaisy.
Wepirati po wansapaya irati wama marova mai muno vatano wo wansave tatugadi mansai tenambe.
Po muinye rarorono wama anene mai,
muno teto Apa urairijo po rave mansai rai tutir.
Apa urairije umaso mamo Po raugaje wama aneno Abraham ai
pare Po wansapaya irati wama marova mansai,
inda vemo wanjaniv nora, yara wamanapatambe Ai kai,
muno wansanuga ndandinit muno wama ana wandave mamaisy no Amune rai arono ta wana no mine vone so rai.
Umba sya arikainyo winy, vatane indati wo nawainamo Amisyo Titi Rave apa anawae pi winy,
weye winyirati nyuisyeve indamu nyo unanuije ratayao Ai.
Indati nyo Amisye apa vatane manyao nyare,
‘Amisye po wapa ayao kakaije rapaya wasai, wea indati wananta irati Apa kove rai.’
Amisye aemeno wansai ti Po apa Mesias atutir de po wansapaya ayao kakaije rai.
Opamo aurata irati uma seo apa kove rautan no awatan ngko dave wemaisy.
Apa vare mbaro vatano una no kaumure ama uga
muno ujanivo wene raije mansai.
Po unanuijo to no saumane rarorono wansai.”

content: Zakaria apa kavo Yohanes umaso panakoe seo to, apa ana datantona ntiti muno apa anave mbambunin. No no nugo vabukane vono maninimbe yava apa masyote mamaisy, umba de po anasine rarorono vatano Israel mansai indamu po Amisye apa ayao raura mai.

footnotes.text: Ayao Yunani naiso mo raura mare, “Yakob apa susye.”
Kaumure raurata irati ayao kakaije rai.
